description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Machina], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (11.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Earth 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Earth Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Earth Ability Quick Cast (Tactical)] to user/[Physical Ability Instant Cast (15s)] to all allies if there are 0-3/4+ Spellblade/Type-0 allies in the party.

description.name: Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Earth attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Earth 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Earth ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Earth Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Earth Ability Quick Cast (Tactical)
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Earth while in Tactical Awoken Mode

description.name: Physical Ability Instant Cast (15s)
description.text: Cast speed x999999 for Physical abilities

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Machina
description.text: Earth abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [111% ATB 1] after using Earth abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 111% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.11
